**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **master** branch:

**dont assume argument lists for column property** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/3025
@zzzeek I tried the latest release, the problem is still present with the same traceback
it's not yet released, you need to install from git to get the fixed version
